name: Transaction.Storage.Push
meaning: Appends a value to an array stored at nameSpace.keyOrIndexOrPath inside $$Transaction.Store (creating it if missing) using JSON.Push, and stores the array back as JSONArray. Returns an empty string.
target_signature: transactionStoragePush(ns: string, path: string, value: unknown, type?: JsonType): void

name: clip_GetFMObjectType
meaning: Reads the clipboard formats (BaseElements call) and maps the FileMaker dyn.* format id to an object type name: Layout Objects, Scripts, Script Steps, Tables, Fields, Custom Functions; else empty. BaseElements plugin function is <Function Missing> in the DDR; its name and behavior are not shown.
open_question: Mac clipboard type ids only; developer tooling with no app-runtime role. Byte-identical body in: karbon_Generator.fmp12#16.

name: clip_GetFMxml
meaning: Reads the FileMaker XML snippet from the clipboard for the dyn.* format. On Mac it writes it to a temp file, runs the tidy command-line tool through a BaseElements call to pretty-print, and reads it back; on other platforms returns the raw XML. BaseElements plugin function is <Function Missing> in the DDR; its name and behavior are not shown.
open_question: Runs a shell command (tidy) with a path built from Get(TemporaryPath). Developer tooling. Byte-identical body in: karbon_Generator.fmp12#17.

name: clip_Set
meaning: Puts XML on the clipboard as pasteable FileMaker objects: wraps in <fmxmlsnippet type="FMObjectList"> if needed, picks the Mac dyn.* or Windows Mac-XM** format for the object type, and writes it through a BaseElements call. BaseElements plugin function is <Function Missing> in the DDR; its name and behavior are not shown.
open_question: Returns whatever the plugin call returns (header says 1 on success). Developer tooling. Windows branch uses "Mac-XM.." format names. Byte-identical body in: karbon_Generator.fmp12#18.
